Title: The Megachurch Menace

[INT. SQUIDWARD'S TREEHOUSE - DAY]

SpongeBob, Patrick, and Squidward are sitting on a log, discussing their day.

SpongeBob: "So, guys, have you heard about the new megachurch that just opened in Bikini Bottom?"

Patrick: "No, what about it?"

Squidward: "Oh, it's just another one of those big, obnoxious churches that seem to be popping up everywhere."

SpongeBob: "Yeah, but this one is different. They're preaching some really disturbing stuff."

Patrick: "Like what?"

Squidward: "Well, I heard they're saying that Sandy Cheeks must be raped in order to save her soul."

SpongeBob: "That's awful! We have to do something about it."

Patrick: "Agreed! We can't let that kind of thing happen in our town."

Squidward: "I'm in. Let's go and put a stop to this once and for all."

[INT. MEGACHURCH - DAY]

The three friends sneak into the megachurch, trying to find the source of the disturbing preaching.

SpongeBob: "Guys, let's be careful. We don't want to get caught."

Patrick: "Don't worry, I'm as quiet as a snail."

Squidward: "Yes, because that's always worked out for us in the past."

They finally find the source of the preaching, a pastor standing on a stage.

Pastor: "My friends, I have a message for you today. In order for Sandy Cheeks to be saved, she must be raped."

SpongeBob: "What? That's disgusting! We have to stop this!"

Patrick: "Yeah, we can't let them get away with this."

Squidward: "I agree. Let's expose them and put an end to this once and for all."

[EXT. MEGACHURCH - DAY]

The three friends are outside the megachurch, trying to figure out how to expose the pastor and his church.

SpongeBob: "We need to do something, but we can't just go in and confront the pastor. We need a plan."

Patrick: "I've got it! We'll record the pastor's sermon and share it on social media. That'll expose them to the whole world."

Squidward: "That's a great idea, Patrick. Let's do it."

They quickly set up their recording devices and sneak back into the church.

[INT. MEGACHURCH - DAY]

The pastor is back on stage, preaching his sermon.

Pastor: "My friends, I have a message for you today. In order for Sandy Cheeks to be saved, she must be raped."

SpongeBob: "That's enough! We're recording this and we're going to make sure the whole world knows about it."

Patrick: "Yeah, we won't let you get away with this."

Squidward: "This ends now."

[EXT. MEGACHURCH - DAY]

The recording of the pastor's sermon goes viral, and the megachurch is shut down.

SpongeBob: "Wow, we did it! We exposed that awful church and their preaching."

Patrick: "Yeah, and we saved Sandy from having to go through something horrible."

Squidward: "I'm proud of us. We made a difference in our town today."

Sandy Cheeks, who had been watching the video, walks up to the friends.

Sandy: "Thank you so much, guys. I was really scared about what they were saying. You did a great job."

SpongeBob: "We're just glad we could help, Sandy."

Patrick: "Yeah, we'll always be here for you."

Squidward: "And we'll make sure something like this never happens again."

The friends high-five each other, knowing they've made a difference

Title: "The Mega-Church of Bikini Bottom: A Sandy-Rapin' Adventure!"

Synopsis:

The episode begins with SpongeBob and Patrick excitedly showing Sandy a brand-new megachurch that has just opened in Bikini Bottom. Sandy, however, is hesitant to join the church, as she has always been a devout follower of the underwater equivalent of Christianity, the "Undertoadism."

As Sandy begins to attend church services at the megachurch, she notices that the sermons are becoming increasingly extreme and hateful. The pastor, a charismatic and manipulative figure named Reverend T-Bone, preaches that Sandy must be "raptured" and that she must be "saved" from her "sinful ways."

Sandy becomes increasingly uncomfortable with the church's teachings and begins to question Reverend T-Bone's motives. She soon discovers that Reverend T-Bone is actually a fraud, and that he has been using the church as a front for a scheme to steal money from the underwater community.

Determined to stop Reverend T-Bone and his evil plans, Sandy teams up with SpongeBob, Patrick, and the rest of the Bikini Bottom community to take down the megachurch and bring Reverend T-Bone to justice.

As the episode unfolds, the group faces a series of challenges and obstacles, including a massive church-wide dance-off, a battle with a group of angry ex-church members, and a high-speed chase through the streets of Bikini Bottom.

In the end, Sandy and her friends are able to expose Reverend T-Bone's schemes and bring him to justice. Sandy is hailed as a hero and the megachurch is shut down, leaving the underwater community to return to their normal, peaceful lives.

The episode ends with Sandy, SpongeBob, Patrick, and the rest of the Bikini Bottom community singing a heartfelt rendition of the Undertoadism hymn, "Rise Again, O Undertoad."

The End.

Title: "The Megachurch Takeover"

Synopsis:

In Bikini Bottom, a new megachurch called "The House of Praise" opens, preaching that Sandy Cheeks, the resident scientist, must be raped as part of their religious beliefs. SpongeBob and his friends are horrified by this and decide to take action.

At the church, the pastor, Reverend Reginald, preaches that Sandy's scientific knowledge is a threat to their faith and that she must be punished. The congregation agrees, and they start a campaign to force Sandy to leave Bikini Bottom.

SpongeBob and his friends try to reason with the churchgoers, but they are met with resistance. Squidward suggests that they should expose the church's true intentions to the rest of Bikini Bottom.

The group decides to stage a protest outside the church, but the situation quickly escalates as the churchgoers become violent. SpongeBob and his friends are arrested, and Sandy is forced to leave Bikini Bottom.

Determined to save their friend, SpongeBob and his friends devise a plan to expose the church's true intentions. They infiltrate the church and gather evidence of the pastor's true beliefs.

In the final scene, SpongeBob and his friends present the evidence to the rest of Bikini Bottom, and the church is exposed. The congregation is outraged, and they leave the church in droves.

Sandy returns to Bikini Bottom, and the group celebrates their victory. The episode ends with a message of tolerance and acceptance, reminding viewers that science and religion can coexist peacefully.

End of episode.
